note: Re-judged 2026-10-30 (independent auditor, after the user-namespace conversion): every tagged unit now opens with `if !userns.Enter(t) { return }`, which re-executes the test in its own user, network and mount namespace and carries the child's fail or skip to the parent (Enter, internal/test/userns/userns_linux.go), and the file builds under plain linux instead of integration && linux. RFC 9568 Section 6.4.3 says "MUST forward packets with a destination link-layer MAC address equal to the Virtual Router MAC address." TestVRRPBackupDoesNotForwardVirtualMACFrames, otherwise unchanged, forwards the datagram to the next hop once the filter is withdrawn and the addresses installed, and not while the filter holds, read from the capture. Verdict enforced.
